text:
emma: Quick shoutout to Rob and Facilities 12 demo turned into an obstacle course but they got AV and seating sorted in 10 mins. absolute legends. :raised_hands:

rob: glad it worked out. special thanks to Facilities for the spare cable and for hauling the extra chairs. also shout to Claire for calm-running the Q&A. :clap:

claire: team effort! huge thanks to everyone who stayed and helped tidy after. tiny thing but it keeps the space usable. :broom:

facilities: happy to help! FYI we'll label the AV bag today so future chaos is slightly less chaotic.

emma: can we get a small treat for Facilities? snackbot, opinions?

snackbot: Poll: "Treat for Facilities"  React: 1 Donuts, 2 Sandwiches, 3 Fruit box. Poll open 24h.

rob: :one: for donuts, bonus points for maple bacon.

claire: :three: for balance. also leaving a short kudos on the board.

kudosbot: Created kudos card: "AV + seating rescue  Rob & Facilities & Claire" (id: K-396543-01). Summary: "Fast triage, calm Q&A, and a cleaner conference room afterwards. Much appreciated."

emma: filing a calendar note and dropping a thank-you sticky on the main desk. small gestures, big morale boost :sparkles:
